      "status": "interpretive"

      "status": "interpretive"

      "locus": "The entire object as a whole",

  "observations": [
    {
      "locus": "left side of the figure's face, including the eye and cheek area covered by a draped material.",

      "surface_light_behavior": "A single, sharp highlight glances off the edge of the draped material near the temple. The light passes through the drapery, illuminating the form beneath while casting complex, dark crevices within the folds.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "The interplay suggests a hard, reflective material like stone that has been carved to simulate both the solidity of skin and the translucency of thin fabric.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "central area of the face, focusing on the nose bridge and lips.",
      "visible_organization": "The features are arranged vertically with a distinct separation between the upper and lower lip, though the line is soft. The nose appears smooth and elongated.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "Soft shadows define the profile of the nose against the cheek area. The skin-like surface reflects light diffusely without sharp specular points, indicating a matte finish.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "The appearance is consistent with polished stone or plaster that has been treated to look like pale human skin under diffuse lighting conditions.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "the hair, visible as a texture above the forehead and around the ears.",
      "visible_organization": "The form is composed of fine, closely packed strands arranged in waves or curls that frame the upper face. The pattern repeats across the crown.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "Small highlights catch on individual strands at random intervals, suggesting an uneven surface texture that scatters light rather than reflecting it uniformly.",
      "apparent_material_effect": "The visual effect implies a carving technique meant to represent dense hair, rendered with enough detail to suggest volume and organic growth patterns.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    },
    {
      "locus": "the dark area occupying the periphery of the image.",
      "visible_organization": "This region forms a solid, featureless background that surrounds the sculpted figure. It lacks internal variation or organization.",
      "surface_light_behavior": "The surface absorbs almost all incident light, appearing as a flat void with no discernible texture or gradient.",

      "uncertainty": "high",

      "apparent_material_effect": "The effect simulates the weight and drape of a heavy textile material, such as wool or linen, sculpted into stone to capture the physics of gravity acting on fabric.",
      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"
    }
  ],
  "cannot_determine": [
    "the exact dimensions or scale of the object relative to a human observer",
    "whether the drapery is made of fabric or carved material"
  ]
}
